# Reviewer Rubric — pointer (not a copy)

The envelope-card review checklist is **not templated here** — it is a single
finalized document that applies to every substrate's card unchanged.

→ **Use `docs/reviewer_rubric.md`.** The external domain expert scores each
envelope-card section PASS/CONCERN/FAIL (regime boundaries, failure-mode
completeness, diagnostics scope, extraction-contract fit, cost model, citations),
returns one of sign-off / sign-off-with-amendments / reject-with-reasons, and
writes the resulting provenance state back into the card's §2 — which is what
advances the substrate up the autonomy ladder (onboarding recipe item 7).

Do not duplicate the rubric's content into a per-substrate file; point at it.
